## ATTRIBUTIONS

Please be sure attribute any content copied or derived from the content of this file as follows:

### MODELS  
   -**"BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan"**  
   The original model can be downloaded [here](https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/download.html).  
      -**"Z-Anatomy - The libre 3D atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0"** 
   
The following works were present in an earlier package revision and are **not included in the current model geometry**:
   -"Anatomy of the Inner Ear - by University of Dundee School of Medicine - CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0"
   -"Kidney - by Lissie Cowley - CC-BY-NC 4.0" 
The Dundee "Cranial Nerves and Foramina" (CC-BY 4.0) derivative remains in the package; its attribution and license terms still apply.

### CURRENT PACKAGE UPDATE (2026-10-14)
The two kidney meshes previously attributed to Lissie Cowley and six inner-ear meshes previously attributed to the University of Dundee (right/left tympanic membrane, vestibule and cochlea) have been replaced. The six malleus, incus and stapes meshes with uncertain source mapping have also been replaced. The new shapes and atlas-frame placements are authored in `scripts/build-original-anatomy.mjs`; no source-mesh vertices are read by that script. These replacement shapes are an initial educational prototype and have not been reviewed by an anatomist or clinician; they must not be described as clinically validated or photorealistic.

The left and right telencephalon white-matter meshes whose upstream attribution was unclear have also been replaced by newly authored procedural geometry and placements in the same script. The source note previously attributed white matter to a University of Washington/Brainder source; that mapping was not sufficiently specific to verify, so the replaced meshes are no longer distributed.

These replacements remove the listed non-commercial geometries from the current GLBs only. They do not clear the rest of this mixed-source package for commercial distribution; retain the applicable attribution and share-alike notices for remaining sources and review all bundled text, volume, and screenshot assets before release.
